original: I have a request for you

I feel really stupid. I was at a fun concert and I lost my phone at the concert. I use the phone for my two-factor authentication. But now I can't get into my account. I need to get in to it to see about my order. Can you help me log in?
I understand your situation, don't worry, I'm going to help you solve it.
ok could you give me your full name or account id please
Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.
Thanks Mr. Joseph. To reset your two-factor authentication, I will be sending a special reset code to your email.
Could you please give me your email address?
Details have been entered for jb521110@email.com.
All set! I have sent the reset code to your email so you can get back into your account.
Also, to be safe, you should follow best practices for security. I'll send you a link about security best practices right now.
A link about security best practices has been sent.
oh great, let me check my email
I got the code and was able to log in! And I see the security link too.
I'm glad! Anything else you need?
no, i don't need anything else
It was a pleasure to help you Mr. Joseph
